# Exploration, Realms and the Town Guide

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_exploration_guide.py; edit exploration/rules.json and language inputs. -->

Suggested route: settle as a mortal, explore the Overworld in Qi Refining, venture into the Nether in Foundation, then prepare for the End in Golden Core. Early entry is allowed; gear, potions, terrain and skill still matter.

These are baseline recommendations. Higher-realm Overworld regions raise local structure advice, ordinary encounters and cultivation rewards.

## Town Guide

An existing local resident becomes the guide in Yunshan’s inn reception area, on duty by day and resting at night. Right-click for your next step, then use the chat link for more tips. Advice reads each player’s realm, initiation and vanilla advancements separately.

`/exploration` shows your current location, `/exploration guide` your next step, `/exploration guide tips` another tip, `/exploration guide where` the assigned guide’s position, and `/exploration catalogue` all baseline advice. Available without operator permission.

The role remains vacant if local candidates or observed facilities are unavailable; no new person is fabricated.

## Overworld

- **Overworld surface：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Establish shelter, food and tools. Local monsters follow the regional realm.
- **Caves and deep mining：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 5** — Bring light, a shield and a retreat route; deep caves contain dark iron.
- **Lush caves：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 4** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Dripstone caves：Qi Refining 2 – Qi Refining 5** — Watch ledges and dripstone. Realm does not remove fall damage.
- **Ocean exploration：Mortal – Qi Refining 5** — Prepare air, visibility and a way back. Health cannot replace oxygen.
- **Village：Mortal – Qi Refining 2** — Trade and resupply. Protect villagers and avoid an unprepared raid.
- **Ruined portal：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Buried treasure：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Trail ruins：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring a brush and avoid breaking suspicious blocks.
- **Igloo：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Shipwreck：Mortal – Qi Refining 4** — Check your air and exit before searching the hold.
- **Ocean ruins：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Prepare air and watch drowned; their tridents scale with their realm.
- **Desert pyramid：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Inspect pressure plates and TNT. Realm advice does not make traps safe.
- **Jungle temple：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Look for tripwires and dispensers before opening chests.
- **Swamp hut：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Prepare for potion effects rather than relying only on health.
- **Mineshaft：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 4** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Monster room：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 4** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Pillager outpost and patrol：Qi Refining 4 – Qi Refining 7** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Woodland mansion：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Prepare for evokers, vexes and axe attacks; avoid pulling several rooms.
- **Stronghold：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Bring eyes of ender and an exit. The End is advised at early Golden Core; boss tuning follows later.
- **Trial chamber：Qi Refining 7 – Qi Refining 9** — Complete a normal trial first. An ominous bottle deliberately raises the challenge.
- **Ominous trial：Foundation Establishment · Middle – Foundation Establishment · Late** — Ominous spawners use a separate realm band. Bring supplies and an exit.
- **Raid：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Protect villagers. Raiders retain their birth realm when moved.
- **Ocean monument：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Prepare air and a plan for mining fatigue. Elder guardians retain vanilla boss statistics in V1.
- **Deep dark：Qi Refining 7 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Sneaking, wool and distractions are more useful than a forced fight.
- **Ancient city：Qi Refining 7 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Low-realm stealth is allowed. Killing the warden is optional; V1 preserves its statistics.

## Nether

- **Nether wastes and forests：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Early Foundation advised. Bring fire resistance, gold gear and return coordinates; lava remains dangerous.
- **Soul sand valley and basalt deltas：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Watch ranged attacks, slowing ground and lava drops; establish a safe route.
- **Nether landmark：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Nether fortress：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Bring fire resistance and watch wither skeletons. Blaze powder, copper and spirit stone craft spirit copper.
- **Bastion remnant：Foundation Establishment · Middle – Foundation Establishment · Late** — Piglin brutes are dangerous. Prepare for late Foundation in treasure areas; stealth remains useful.

## End (guidance only in V1)

- **End islands：Golden Core · Early – Golden Core · Middle** — Early Golden Core advised. V1 provides guidance only; End mobs and bosses are not retuned yet.
- **End city and ship：Golden Core · Early – Golden Core · Middle** — Prepare for levitation, falls and the void. End reward integration follows in a later version.

## Exploration Rewards

Selected vanilla chests and normal/ominous vaults append bounded cultivation supplies alongside vanilla loot, scaled to local risk. Mob drops, repeatable spawner payouts and villager trades do not receive this bonus. Previously opened chests are not refilled.

Blaze powder + a common copper ingot + a low-grade spirit stone craft one spirit copper ingot for channeling forging. Qi infusion at the ding remains an alternative.

V1 does not retune End mobs, the dragon, wither, warden or elder guardians. Their dedicated balancing follows later.
